name: GhostDataTablePreset
description: Batteries-included default child of GhostDataTable (spec example (a′)). Renders a labelled global search field, a selection column with a select-all checkbox, an expansion column with labelled expand buttons and detail rows, sort buttons for sortable columns, and a GhostEmptyState row when nothing renders. Each column id is an optional typed cell slot like GhostDataTableTable; #detail, #toolbar, and #search add or replace content. Use it instead of a manual #default composition, not next to one.

props.name: columns
props.description:
Columns to render, in order, matched to the parent `GhostDataTable`
columns by `id` (ids the parent does not have are skipped). Defaults to
every parent column. Pass the same array you give `GhostDataTable` to
type the `#<columnId>` slots.

props.name: containHorizontal
props.description:
When true, wraps the table in a scroll container for explicit horizontal
overflow. The table itself never receives implicit overflow.

props.name: emptyHeadingLevel
props.description:
Heading level of the empty-state title. Match the page outline (axe
`heading-order`): one below the nearest heading above the table.

props.name: emptyTitle
props.description: Visible title of the `GhostEmptyState` shown when no rows render.

props.name: expansionHeaderLabel
props.description:
Accessible name of the expansion column header (visually hidden text in
the `<th>`).

props.name: layoutSlots
props.description: Opt into the named layout slots on this preset. Omit to keep all four names available for cells.

props.name: rowExpansionLabel
props.description: Accessible name of a row's expand button.

props.name: rowSelectionLabel
props.description: Accessible name of a row's selection checkbox.

props.name: scrollLabel
props.description:
Accessible name for the horizontal scroll region. When omitted and a
{@link GhostTableCaption } is rendered, the scroll region uses `aria-labelledby`
on the caption id.

props.name: searchLabel
props.description: Visible label of the default search field.

props.name: selectAllLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the select-all checkbox.

props.name: selectionHeaderLabel
props.description:
Accessible name of the selection column header (`aria-label` on the
`<th>`, which holds only the select-all checkbox).

props.name: showGlobalFilter
props.description:
Shows the search field (or `#search` slot). Defaults to `true` when any
column takes part in the global filter (an accessor and
`enableColumnFilter !== false`).

slots.name: detail
slots.description: Content of an expanded row's detail `<tr>` (one cell spanning the row).

slots.name: search

props.name: setValue
props.description: Commits a global filter through the root (resets the page on server filtering).

props.name: value
props.description: Current global filter as text (`''` when cleared).

slots.description: Replaces the default search field (for example to debounce input).

slots.name: toolbar
slots.description: Rendered before the search field and the table.

keyboard.Tab: Moves between the search field, the select-all checkbox, sort buttons, row checkboxes, and expand buttons in DOM order. No grid or roving cell focus.
keyboard.Space: Toggles a focused selection checkbox, or activates a focused sort or expand button.
keyboard.Enter: Activates a focused sort or expand button. Does not toggle checkboxes.

spec.evidence: Zac approved the headless spec in PR #272 and the themed addendum in PR #374 (merge 5fd3fd46).
